categories.name: Hot Wallet Infrastructure
controls: Hot wallet container must NOT run as root
Hot wallet pod must have NetworkPolicy restricting ingress to signing service only
Private keys must NEVER appear in ENV, ConfigMap, or image layers
HSM or KMS required for key storage (not filesystem)

categories.name: Cold Wallet / Custody
controls: Cold wallet must be air-gapped (no internet connectivity)
Hardware security module (HSM) for master key

categories.name: Trading Engine
controls: Rate limiting on order placement API
Order book access restricted by NetworkPolicy
Audit log for all order mutations (immutable)
Withdrawal velocity limits enforced at infrastructure level

categories.name: API Security
controls: TLS 1.3 minimum on all external endpoints
JWT token rotation < 15 minutes for trading sessions
IP allowlisting for institutional API access
DDoS protection required on all public endpoints
